```js
function validate(payload) { return payload != null; }
```
Add a validation layer to the endpoint before it processes the payload, then return the error envelope.
Requirement 4 says the endpoint must be idempotent and that a reference list is required.
Consider putting Redis in front of the endpoint, because that is how this pattern is usually scaled.
Your approach is correct and you are on the right track with this design.

cleanAnswer.answer: Idempotent means that doing the same operation more than once has the same effect as doing it once. It is a general property of an operation, not a statement about your work.
